visual_action: A montage shows Donald Trump, as president, participating in a dignified transfer ceremony for fallen soldiers on an airport tarmac. The video includes shots of military aircraft (Air Force One and a cargo plane), Trump shaking hands with and saluting alongside uniformed military personnel, and soldiers carrying flag-draped caskets from the cargo plane into a van. Melania Trump and other officials are also present, watching the ceremony. The video concludes with a title card for 'The White House'.
